_meta.note: Pace number cases (BEHAVIOR-SPEC section 6.1, CCRM-97 (Pace Number)) and the session-binding predicate (section 6.2, CCRM-96 (Weekly First)). Spec-first: written 2026-11-02 before any client implements them, so the expectations are computed from the formulas in section 6.1 (scripted, not by hand), not ported from passing tests. The pace cases include the six ModelMesh docs/pace-metric.md scenarios.
_meta.inputs: elapsedPct is section 6's elapsedPercent (0..100). usedPct null means no reading. msUntilReset is reset instant minus now.

pace.name: owner's example, A
pace.why: Used 60 at mid-window: 40% left for 50% of the time. Slow down by a fifth.

pace.name: owner's example, B
pace.why: 25% left with 1% of the window to go: almost all of it would expire.

pace.name: fresh, early
pace.why: Ratio (used/elapsed) reads 200% here; Pace stays near zero.

pace.name: same +10 gap, early
pace.why: Gap +10, but 85% left for 95% of the week: mild.

pace.name: same +10 gap, late
pace.why: Gap +10, but 10% left for 20% of the week: exactly the slowDown/nearlyOut edge (50 is slowDown).

pace.name: both behind, B
pace.why: 60% left expires in a tenth of the window.

pace.name: one exhausted
pace.why: Nothing left: +100, and the band is spent.

pace.name: window start
pace.why: 0/0 is the sweet spot, never a division by zero.

pace.name: reset reached with quota left
pace.why: No time left: -100, the window resets now.

pace.name: band edge -50 is roomToSpare
pace.why: -50 inclusive stays roomToSpare; useBeforeReset is strictly below -50.

pace.name: band edge +50 is slowDown
pace.why: +50 inclusive stays slowDown; nearlyOut is strictly above +50.

pace.name: spent line
pace.why: usedPct >= 99.5 is spent whatever the pace (BEHAVIOR-SPEC section 7.2's exhausted line).

allowance.name: exactly one day left counts as days
allowance.why: The switch to hours is strictly under 24 h.

allowance.name: last day switches to hours
allowance.why: 40% at 160%/day is true but useless; say 40% left for 6 h.

allowance.name: spent has no allowance
allowance.why: Nothing left to pace; the surface says when it comes back instead.

sessionBinding.name: 5h past 90
sessionBinding.why: The orange step (BEHAVIOR-SPEC section 5) is where 5h becomes the limit about to stop you.

sessionBinding.name: 5h at exactly 90
sessionBinding.why: Strict, like the orange step: 90.0 is still yellow.

sessionBinding.name: 5h projected to hit before its reset
no 5h window on the plan
sessionBinding.why: ChatGPT Pro, Claude Ultra: the session is absent, never binding.

sessionBinding.name: week spent outranks the 5h
sessionBinding.why: With the week spent the 5h cannot be used; Weekly stays the headline.

sessionBinding.name: no weekly reading still lets 5h bind
